explanation: Erdős #1183 (Erdős–Ulam): estimate f(n), the guaranteed size of a monochromatic family of subsets of [n] closed under ∪ and ∩ (IsSublattice) in any 2-colouring. "Estimate" is read as Θ of an unknown answer function. The site notes only f(n) ≥ (n+1)/2 is known. The statement is faithful and open.
